name: Membership Task Force
description:
The mission of the Membership Task Force is to strengthen engagement within W3C membership and to ensure a healthy and diverse membership. To do so it draws from insights gained from members and the community.

Objectives:

  • Establish measures and proxy measures to understand our impact through a survey and interviews as deliverables.
  • Recommend methods for W3C members to fully enjoy the membership experience at W3C.

      • This group operates in Member-only space.
